headline: Price beats Doets 16-13 and Van Veen sees off Van Gerwen 16-11
standfirst: Gerwyn Price and Gian van Veen, the world No 4 and No 3, will contest the Grand Slam of Darts final after two semi-finals that went to the higher-ranked players.
body: The Grand Slam of Darts final will be between the two highest-ranked players left in Wolverhampton. Gerwyn Price, ranked fourth, beat Kevin Doets 16-13 in the first semi-final, and Gian van Veen, ranked third, beat Michael van Gerwen 16-11 in the second.

Price won the title in 2018 and is now one match from a fourth Grand Slam crown. Doets, ranked 23rd and playing the event for the first time on record, kept the semi-final within a leg or two for most of the way before Price pulled clear in the closing stages.

Van Veen's win ends a run that had made Van Gerwen the story of the quarter-finals. The 11th-ranked Dutchman won this event in 2017 and had beaten Tom Sykes 16-11 in a match containing two nine-darters, but he could not hold off a player who had lost to him in 10 of their previous 14 meetings. Van Veen's best at this tournament before this year was a quarter-final in 2024.

The semi-finals also made some history for the Netherlands. With Doets, Van Gerwen and Van Veen all in the last four, it was only the second time three Dutch players had reached the semi-finals of the same PDC premier event, after the 2025 European Championship. Half of the quarter-final field was Dutch, and one of them is still standing.
